description: Pre-online check (streaming): from asleep the vehicle only probes, and a bare online answer without vehicle data connects the stream to check whether the online is real before any vehicle data is requested. Branch 'stream connected to check for real online', then a frame with power nil ('subsystem check detected, treating as fake online'): the check is confirmed fake, every further probe keeps the machine asleep without loading vehicle data. Pin: only the asleep row, no position, one stream connect. The bare online terminal repeats through the probe without writing.
